sections.title: Professional Movers for Pacific Palisades Households
sections.content: Since the Palisades Fire, many households here have moved more than once: into a rental, sometimes a second one, and for some, back to a repaired or rebuilt home. If you need a Pacific Palisades moving company that can also store your furniture between those moves, SOS Moving handles both. Why Palisades households book SOS Moving: Licensed & Insured: CPUC licensed (CAL-T0192140) and registered under USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, with full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Top-Rated: Rated 4.9 on Google across 1,007 reviews and  across 1,585 reviews. Straight Pricing: Two movers and a truck from $119/hr Monday–Thursday (cash rate) or $135/hr Friday–Sunday, with stairs, long carries and extra stops included. Our moving services in Pacific Palisades include apartment moves, storage and white glove care for the pieces that matter most. Call 909-443-0004, Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM.

sections.title: Careful Packing for Pacific Palisades Homes
sections.content: Some Palisades households are packing a full house; others are packing a smaller set of items salvaged from the property. We wrap both with the same care and label every box for where it is headed: the rental, storage or the finished home. How we pack a Palisades move: Salvaged Pieces: Tell us which items were recovered from the property, and we wrap them individually and pack them apart from the rest of the load. Storage-Ready: Furniture headed to storage goes out in moving blankets and shrink wrap, and every item is inventoried before it is loaded. Included Extras: Blankets, shrink wrap, packing tape, wardrobe boxes, furniture disassembly and TV unmounting come with every hourly move at no added cost. Add full or partial packing to any move, or pair it with storage so everything stays wrapped and inventoried until the house is ready.

sections.title: Moving Within the Palisades and Across the Westside
sections.content: We work as local movers in Pacific Palisades and as long-distance movers for moves out of California, so a Westside rental move now and a bigger relocation later can go through one company. Most people displaced by the fires have stayed close to home, many renting in Santa Monica and Brentwood, so a typical move here starts with a short drive along Sunset Boulevard or Pacific Coast Highway. What we plan around on Palisades streets: Pinch Points: The city's rebuild traffic plan names Sunset at Chautauqua, Temescal Canyon and Pacific Coast Highway as constrained intersections, and Caltrans repair work still closes lanes on PCH near Sunset, so we set arrival windows with both in mind. Narrow Streets: A city-commissioned report found almost all streets in the Alphabet Streets, Rustic Canyon and Castellammare narrower than fire code allows, so we match the truck and parking plan to your block before move day. Rebuild Sites: Where contractors, deliveries and storage containers share the curb, we confirm access with you or your builder ahead of time. Stairs, long carries and extra stops stay inside the hourly rate. See how our local moving service works, or ask for a long-distance quote if you are leaving California.

sections.title: Long-Distance Movers for Pacific Palisades Families
sections.content: Many families who lost homes in the LA fires have bought outside the burn zones instead of returning. Outside Los Angeles, displaced Palisadians have tended to stay near the coast from San Diego to Santa Barbara counties, while Texas, Florida and New York were the top out-of-state destinations for people displaced by the fires. How we handle a long-distance move from the Palisades: Coast or Cross-Country: We run moves up and down the California coast and across state lines, picking up from a Westside rental, a standing home or our storage facility. Direct From Storage: Belongings stored with us while you decide can go straight from storage to the new address, with no extra stop on the Westside. Interstate Authority: Out-of-state moves run under USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, backed by full liability coverage. Staying in Los Angeles after all? Our local moving crews handle the shorter trips, and you can request a long-distance quote through our free estimate form.

sections.title: Commercial Moves in Pacific Palisades
sections.content: With Palisades Village reopened and many of its tenants back, our commercial movers help Palisades shops and offices move furniture, fixtures and inventory.

faq.question: Can you store our belongings while our Pacific Palisades home is rebuilt?
faq.answer: Yes. We pick up, wrap and inventory everything, keep it in our storage facility and deliver it when the house is ready, and the storage period can be extended if construction runs long. It also keeps furniture out of street-parked containers, which drew towing warnings in the Palisades before the city paused enforcement.

faq.question: We're moving from one temporary rental to another. Can you help?
faq.answer: Yes. Many displaced Palisades households have already stayed in more than one place, and we move apartments and rental houses across the Westside the same way we move full homes. If the next rental is smaller, the extra furniture can go into our storage until the rebuild is done.

faq.question: When should we book the move back into a rebuilt Palisades home?
faq.answer: Aim for a date after the city issues your certificate of occupancy, the final step in the rebuilding process, so a late inspection doesn't push your move. If your things are in our storage, we deliver them straight to the house, reassemble the furniture and place it where you want it. Same-day moves are possible when a crew is available, but booking ahead gives you more choice of dates.

faq.question: How do you handle items salvaged from a fire-damaged Palisades home?
faq.answer: Tell us which pieces were recovered from the property, and we wrap each one individually and pack them apart from the rest of the load. For artwork, antiques or keepsakes that need more care, our white glove service covers packing, unpacking and placement.

faq.question: What is included in the hourly rate for a Palisades move?
faq.answer: Two movers and a truck start at $119/hr Monday–Thursday at the cash rate and $135/hr Friday–Sunday, with stairs, long carries and extra stops included. There is a $30 gas fee and a $50 deposit that is applied toward your total; pianos are $200 and items heavier than 300 lbs are $150. Double Drive Time applies to longer local moves under CPUC rules, and long-distance moves are quoted separately.
